svg.text: Degree 2 • 8-entry RPT • 4-entry fully associative prefetch buffer • 32-bit address / 128-bit data
stride, confidence, valid, PC tag match
H0–H3: per-entry valid AND matching tag; read demand and enable qualify the buffer hit.
Named nets D0–D3 connect the four data registers to the MUX; hit_idx selects the returned line.
Main Memory Interface & L1 Response Selection
Response control: buffer hit / in-flight merge, arbiter state and bypass mode.
Blue: address / data • Purple: control • Green: memory interface • Red: hit / coherence | Named nets indicate connections without crossing unrelated blocks.
